blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Police arrested two men and seized two pistols and prohibited drugs from them on Thursday night, Nov. 19, in Pigcawayan, North Cotabato. The arrest came after a brief pursuit operation in Barangay Midpapan 1, Pigcawayan, North Cotabato. Two .45-caliber pistols, ammunition, and suspected illegal drugs were seized from the suspects, identified only as alias “Asad,” 37, and alias “Mars,” 23, both residents of Barangay Central Labas, Midsayap, North Cotabato.
